items.text: On January 19, 1953, 68% of all television sets in the United States were tuned to I Love Lucy.
items.question: Where were you living when I Love Lucy was on, and whose television did you watch it on?
items.source_quote: January 19 – 68% of all television sets in the United States are tuned into I Love Lucy to watch Lucille Ball give birth.

items.text: Postage for a domestic letter was 3 cents an ounce.

items.text: Assembly of the first Chevrolet Corvette was completed in Flint, Michigan, on June 30, 1953.
items.question: Do you remember the first time you saw a Chevrolet Corvette, and who was driving it?
items.source_quote: June 30 – Assembly of the first Chevrolet Corvette is completed in Flint, Michigan.

items.text: The Korean War ended on July 27, 1953, when an armistice agreement was signed.
items.question: Where were you when you heard the Korean War was over, and who told you?
items.source_quote: July 27 – The Korean War ends: The United States, the People's Republic of China, North Korea and South Korea sign an armistice agreement.
